# Sillar UI

> Accessible React components, semantic design tokens, and polished light and dark themes. Made with love in the Dominican Republic by @uppy19d0.

Sillar UI is an MIT-licensed React 18+ component library written in TypeScript. It owns its interaction foundations and has no Radix UI or other primitive runtime dependency.

## Install

```bash
npm install sillar-ui
```

Import `sillar-ui/styles.css` once. Import from `sillar-ui` for convenience or a component entry such as `sillar-ui/dialog`, `sillar-ui/button`, or `sillar-ui/combobox` for focused bundles.

## Public component families

Accordion, Badge, Button, Callout, Card, Checkbox, Collapsible, Combobox, DatePicker, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Field, Form, IconButton, Input, Label, NavigationMenu, Popover, Progress, RadioGroup, Section, Select (native and composed), Separator, Skeleton, Slot, Switch, Tabs, Textarea, Toast, Tooltip, VisuallyHidden, and SkipLink.

## Accessibility

Interactive primitives use semantic HTML and WAI-ARIA patterns, preserve controlled and uncontrolled state, expose state through `data-state`, support keyboard focus behavior, and respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. See the component reference for keyboard commands.
